hook: I broke prod today assuming high GPU util meant healthy inference. Turns out, KV Cache exhaustion was silently killing throughput, but traditional metrics didn't show it until users complained.

hook: It's tempting to blame the LLM when RAG output goes awry, or to rework the prompt. But get this: 67% of top-20 chunk retrieval failures? Those were fixed by improving retrieval, not the generator. Anthropic even dropped their failure rate from 5.7% to 1.9% just by adding reranking. We're quick to blame the LLM, but often it's just dealing with crummy input.
closing_line: So, how do you actually isolate retrieval quality from LLM generation in your RAG pipelines?
reply_seed: Mostly by using retrieval metrics like MRR or NDCG on a golden dataset. Or just a manual check of retrieved chunks for 10-20 known hard queries before touching the LLM.
